name: Hitozuma no Ana ~Ano Ko wa Koko kara Umaretekita no yo~
original_name: 人妻の穴～あの子はここから生まれてきたのよ～
source:
The protagonist just started teaching at So-and-So Academy.
Housewives and mothers were very involved in the school, very hands-on, and very sensual.

Before long he was in an illicit affair with a popular wife. Once he'd tasted the life of infidelity... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092331.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公刚刚开始在某所学园任教。
学生的母亲们积极参与学校事务，不但亲力亲为，更是风情万种。

没过多久，他便与一名颇受欢迎的人妻发生了不伦关系。尝过偷情的滋味后……

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092331.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
